# Test Record Details

The test record is the detailed test document required for electrical equipment. It must be reviewed by professional electrical workers. All inspection work should be carried out in accordance with the requirements of electrical safety inspection of electrical equipment. “Safety Control Method for Using Electrical Equipment” and “Safety Technical Specifications for Static Electrical Equipment” regulations. When recording, check whether the test content is recorded in each column of the test record. Only after the test is accurate and the record is complete can the test record be accepted.

# Fill in content description
1) Equipment name plate/label information (if any)
2) Standard name/number
3) Equipment name
4) Equipment type/series
5) Equipment model
6) Manufacturer
7) Serial Number
8) Equipment address (location of the equipment)
